# Application Testing Standards

This directory contains enterprise standards for test strategy and verification. They define the shared vocabulary of test types and the requirement that a declared type be a real, CI-invoked capability — the verification substrate the quality and seam-contract standards bind to.
page_texts.4:
[standards/application/testing/README.md#std-app-test-001-test-type-taxonomy--operational-harness-standard]

### STD-APP-TEST-001: Test-Type Taxonomy & Operational-Harness Standard

Defines the closed test-type taxonomy (unit, component, integration, contract, e2e, policy, load, chaos, architecture, property) and mandates that every declared type resolve to an operational harness invoked in CI, with binary-runner detection keyed on the CI step.
page_texts.5:
[standards/application/testing/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- A single, closed vocabulary of test types that requirements bind to
- "Declared" means "operational and CI-invoked" — no verification named but never built
- NFRs, invariants, and seam contracts have a real harness behind every verification claim

> Language-specific unit/component testing mechanics remain governed by the per-language technology standards (`STD-TEC-*`).
